name: Default
shortDescription: Rule-based library cleanup for Plex, Jellyfin and Emby: collects unwatched or stale titles, shows them on the server for a grace period, then removes them from the media server, Sonarr, Radarr and Seerr.

alerts.message: Maintainerr has no login of its own, so the template puts it behind HTTP basic auth: sign in with MAINTAINERR_USERNAME and MAINTAINERR_PASSWORD from the environment variables. Then connect a Plex, Jellyfin or Emby server reachable from this host in Settings.
